meta.name: esm
meta.description: Use when working directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 运行 ESM 模型进行蛋白质结构预测与推理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要预测蛋白质结构或运行 ESM 模型推理。
copy.tagline_en: Predict protein structures and run ESM model inference
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to predict protein structures or run ESM model inference.

howto.what: Claude 会参照 ESM 技能,在涉及 `esm` Python SDK、ESM3/ESMC 模型、Forge/Biohub 推理或 ESMFold2 折叠时,提供对应的 Python 代码示例,涵盖生成蛋白质序列、预测结构、逆折叠和计算嵌入。
howto.when: 当任务直接使用 `esm` Python SDK、ESM3/ESMC 模型、Forge/Biohub 推理客户端等 ESM 工作流时触发。

say.text: 请用 ESM3 补全这段蛋白质序列:MPRT___KEND。
say.note: Claude 会给出补全序列的代码和输出。

say.text: 用 ESM C 给这几个序列算嵌入,并比较相似度。
say.note: Claude 会展示调用 ESMC 提取嵌入的代码。

say.text: 用 ESM3 从结构文件生成序列,做逆折叠。
say.note: Claude 会提供从 PDB 生成序列的代码。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude provides Python code and guidance for `esm` SDK, ESM3/ESMC models, Forge/Biohub inference, and ESMFold2, covering sequence generation, structure prediction, inverse folding, and embeddings.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user works directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3/ESMC models, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or similar ESM workflows.

say_en.text: Please use ESM3 to complete this protein sequence: MPRT___KEND.
say_en.note: Claude will provide code to complete the sequence and show output.

say_en.text: Use ESM C to compute embeddings for these sequences and compare similarity.
say_en.note: Claude will show code for getting embeddings with ESMC.

say_en.text: Use ESM3 to inverse fold from a structure file to a sequence.
say_en.note: Claude will provide code to generate a sequence from a PDB.
